profile.heading: Public profile
profile.handleHelp: It appears on your profile and in the ranking, instead of your e-mail address.

language.heading: Interface language
language.label: Language
language.help: It also applies to the e-mails Overpass sends you.

password.heading: Password
password.intro: After the change, your other sessions are closed. This one stays open.
password.done: Password changed. Your other sessions are closed.
password.help: At least 10 characters. A phrase of a few words is both safe and easy to remember.

tokens.heading: MCP tokens and API keys
tokens.intro: A token lets your coding assistant or your scripts read Overpass on your behalf. It can neither create other tokens nor change your account.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.nameHelp: To recognise it later, for example "Laptop, VS Code".
tokens.createdText: It will never be shown again. Overpass only keeps a fingerprint of it.
tokens.configText: The token is already filled in. Copy your editor's configuration before closing this panel.
tokens.expiresOn: Expires on {{date}}, renew it before then.
tokens.revokeText: Tools that use it lose access at once. This cannot be undone.
tokens.emptyText: Create a token to connect the MCP server to your coding assistant.

account.heading: Delete the account
account.intro: Your account, your stacks and your tokens are erased at once. This cannot be undone.
account.confirmText: Your account, your stacks and your tokens will be erased. There is no way back.
